mapper.sql: r.repair_id, r.shop_dept_id, sd.dept_name as shop_dept_name, r.oe_item_id, i.oe_item_code, coalesce(nullif(r.oe_item_name, ''), i.oe_item_name) as oe_item_name, r.repair_quantity, r.estimated_repair_amount, r.available_quota_amount, r.fault_description, r.image_urls, r.exception_approved, r.exception_type, r.advance_months, r.status, r.applicant_id, r.applicant_name, r.approved_by, r.approved_time, r.submitted_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark
from oa_fixed_asset_repair r left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = r.shop_dept_id left join inv_oe_item i on i.oe_item_id = r.oe_item_id and i.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into oa_fixed_asset_repair ( shop_dept_id, oe_item_id, oe_item_name, repair_quantity, estimated_repair_amount, available_quota_amount, fault_description, image_urls, exception_approved, exception_type, advance_months, status, applicant_id, applicant_name, approved_by, approved_time, submitted_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{shopDeptId}, #{oeItemId}, #{oeItemName}, #{repairQuantity}, #{estimatedRepairAmount}, #{availableQuotaAmount}, #{faultDescription}, #{imageUrls}, #{exceptionApproved}, #{exceptionType}, #{advanceMonths}, #{status}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{approvedBy}, #{approvedTime}, #{submittedTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
